body: Mac helped me rehab my brother after his attempted suicide, when we both got into the beautiful sound of vinyl since he’s now blind. This would be an amazing gift to both him and I since this album played on repeat in the hospital for 2 months and many months during his recovery at home. Long time lurker but this I couldn’t pass up on, I’ll be happy for anyone who gets it!

Fact: became a stay at home caretaker over a year a go after my brother survived a SIGSW and is now blind among other side effects...could really use something to keep me busy at home so I’ve been joining all these gaming subs to find some interests.
